source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check HDD could be insert/remove
 
1. Insert HDD to BP.
2. Remove HDD form BP.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure HDD could insert/remove normally.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator plug/unplug with `lsblk` and a 30-line dmesg tail.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly preserves operator hot-plug but omits SAS address, enclosure/controller, multipath and full event evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds inactive-target, HBA/RAID/multipath, hot-swap and per-cycle controls.

original_test_intent: Verify normal physical insertion/removal for every project-selected SAS/SATA drive and bay, with clean link enumeration/disappearance and no unintended RAID, multipath, OS or BMC impact.
original_method: For each serial/bay pair, an operator uses the documented carrier and power-state procedure; the agent records HBA/RAID enclosure and SAS-address mapping, multipath/OS events and BMC health around each physical action.
manual_activity: Mechanical carrier insertion/removal and seating are the acceptance target. Automated enumeration cannot perform or judge that work, so MANUAL ONLY applies.
required_inputs: All in-scope SAS/SATA drive serial/model/carrier and enclosure/bay map
Bay hot-swap capability and safe power/ESD procedure
SAS address, HBA/RAID membership, multipath, mount/boot/data status
Cycle count, order, final state and normal mechanical criteria
Operator, OOB and failed-link recovery plan
safety_requirements: Never remove an active boot, mount, RAID member, multipath path, protected/data-bearing or unknown drive without explicit plan.
Verify enclosure/bay/SAS address/serial before each action.
Use only documented powered hot-swap behavior and proper carrier/ESD handling.
Stop on connector/latch resistance, link/media/controller/power/thermal faults or unexpected path loss.
No automatic rescan, power cycle, reseat or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate full population and inactive/safe target state.
Capture full HBA/RAID, SAS link, udev/journal, multipath and BMC windows per operator action.
Confirm only the expected serial/path appears or disappears and no array/mount changed.
Compile Tool Results without mechanical or verdict claims.
engineer_actions: Approve targets/power state and perform every insertion/removal.
Record mechanical seating, carrier/latch and physical abnormalities.
Review path/health evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful but insufficient: `lsblk` lacks enclosure/SAS/multipath truth and a 30-line tail may omit events; neither proves mechanical behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use controller/HBA enclosure and SAS-address inventory plus full time-bounded udev/journal/multipath/BMC evidence, with `lsblk` supplemental.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All SAS/SATA, insert/remove and 15/8-minute fields are preserved; unspecified cycles remain a project input.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a checked serial/SAS-address/enclosure/bay matrix with operator physical notes and complete per-action link/path telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact SAS/SATA drives, carriers, backplane, expander and HBA/RAID controller.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record HBA/controller/backplane/BMC firmware and OS driver/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds multipath/array/data safeguards and traceability without replacing physical work.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enumeration cannot prove seating force, latch quality or carrier fit.

project_override_considerations: The project defines which SAS/SATA combinations constitute `all`; the report must list them and cannot extrapolate beyond tested media, carriers or bays.
expected_evidence: Approved population, SAS-address/bay map, hot-swap and inactive-target proof
Matching HBA/RAID, multipath, udev/kernel and BMC events
Final drive/path/array/mount health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion both address normal physical insertion/removal. Missing population and cycle details are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core test is clear and manually executable when targets and safe procedures are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains enumeration support but rejects truncated OS-only evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps SAS/HBA/multipath safeguards and applies MANUAL ONLY to physical acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes every claimed drive/bay cycle independently traceable.

review_improvement: Prevents clean `lsblk` output from masking mechanical or multipath/array risks.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source is a physical serviceability check, not merely an enumeration test. Therefore the operator owns the core action and MANUAL ONLY is correct.
no_automatic_retry: Do not rescan, reseat, repeat, power-cycle or fail over paths automatically after a fault. Preserve evidence and escalate.
